anatomy.coordinateSpace: source quadrant-local: down, up, left, right; splitY recorded
anatomy.method: manual reconstruction from temples, cheek, jaw, ear insertion and cranium under hair or hat; NOT silhouette or exposed skin bounding box
anatomy.uncertainty: Occluded skull boundaries are manual estimates (approximately 8-12 source pixels); visual side-by-side review is required.
anatomy.excluded: animal ears, human external ears, hair volume, ponytails, cowlick, hat, crown, costume and weapon
anatomy.directionReview: four separately reviewed skull estimates; one uniform scale, no per-direction resizing
